blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automated identification of individual animals is moving from small curated studies toward shared benchmarks and reusable foundation models. This progress is useful, but current evaluation leaves the evidence behind a match unresolved, i.e., high retrieval accuracy does not show whether a model used animal features or identity-correlated shortcuts. We address this with Counterfactual Foreground Retrieval (CFR), an evidence-aware evaluation protocol. CFR evaluates the same query-gallery task under different views: full image, foreground-only, and shortcut-only. The full-image measures standard retrieval performance; the foreground-only measures foreground-supported retrieval; and shortcut-only view measure how much identity signal is recoverable from background, or silhouette. This turns a retrieval score into an evidence profile: how well the model performs on the original images, how much of that performance remains when only the animal is visible, and how much identity signal remains recoverable when the animal is removed. We release around 0.5M masks for 34 datasets and code for mask generation and CFR evaluation.
blocks.zh: 个体动物的自动识别正在从小的经整理的研究转向共同的基准和可重复使用的基础模型。 这一进展是有用的,但目前的评价留下了未解决的匹配后的证据,即高检索精度并不能显示一个模型是使用了动物特征还是身份相关快捷键. 我们用反事实前景检索(CFR)作为证据认知评价协议来解决这个问题。 CFR在不同的视图下评价相同的查询-采集任务:完整图像,仅展望,以及仅快捷键. 全图像测量标准检索性能;仅前地测量前地支持的检索;以及仅快捷视图测量从背景中可回收多少身份信号,或 silhouette. 这使得一个检索分数变成了一个证据简介:模型在原始图像上的表现如何,当只有动物可见时,该性能还剩下多少,当动物被移除时,还有多少身份信号可以恢复. 我们发布大约0.5M口罩,用于34个数据集和代码,用于制造口罩和CFR评价.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Identifying individual animals across time and space is central to many ecological studies, e.g., population estimation, survival, and movement [ 26 , 36 ] . Automating this task is increasingly important as manual photo-identification is slow, unreliable, labor-intensive, and hard to scale [ 42 ] . As a result, the field is moving from proprietary design and deployment towards open benchmarks and reusable foundation models [ 12 , 30 ] .
This shift has made methods easier to compare and potentially deploy, but it has also exposed a weakness in their evaluation. A correct retrieval does not necessarily mean that the model used the biometric the dataset was built around, such as a coat pattern, an arrangement of facial scales, or a fin contour. It may also be driven by background, capture context, near-duplicates, training-set overlap, or by body outline in species whose identity comes from a surface pattern (see Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
跨越时间和空间识别个体动物是许多生态研究的核心,例如人口估计、生存和运动[26、36]。 将这项任务自动化越来越重要,因为人工摄影识别过程缓慢,不可靠,劳动力密集,且难以扩展[42]. 因此,外地正在从专有设计和部署转向开放的基准和可重复使用的基础模型[12、30]。
这种转变使方法更容易比较和可能部署,但也暴露了评价中的弱点。 正确的检索并不一定意味着模型使用了数据集围绕的生物鉴别技术,如外衣图案,面部鳞片的安排,或鳍轮廓. 它也可能由背景,捕捉背景,近似重复,训练组合重叠,或由特征来自表面模式的物种的体型轮廓驱动(见Tab. 1).

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Strong retrieval scores depend on different evidence. Standard retrieval reports whether the correct individual is retrieved, but not which visual evidence supports it. We therefore introduce the Shortcut Signal Indicator (SSI), which measures how much of the full-image retrieval signal can be recovered from shortcut-only inputs. Among otherwise strong results, SSI ranges from almost zero to almost one, showing why retrieval performance should be evaluated along with the evidence behind it.
blocks.zh: 图1 强检索分数取决于不同的证据. 标准检索报告是否检索到正确的个人,但不报告哪些视觉证据支持它. 因此,我们采用了快捷信号指标(SSI),该指标可以衡量从快捷输入中回收多少完整的图像检索信号。 在否则很强的成果中,SSI从几乎零到几乎1不等,说明为什么应该连同其背后的证据一起评价检索性能。

blocks.en: This ambiguity matters because the settings in which the methods for automated identification are used are usually far from the benchmark. Field images vary across cameras, observers, locations, seasons, and capture conditions. If an evaluation rewards context that correlates with identity, its accuracy can overstate the model’s reliability once deployed. The core evaluation question should therefore not only be whether a model retrieves the correct individual, but what evidence makes it possible.
blocks.zh: 这种模糊性很重要,因为使用自动识别方法的设置通常与基准相去甚远。 场景画面因相机,观察者,地点,季节,捕捉条件而异. 如果评价奖励与身份相关的情况,其准确性一旦部署,可过分强调模型的可靠性。 因此,核心评价问题不仅应是一个模型是否检索到正确的个人,而且还应是什么证据使它成为可能。

blocks.en:
We address this with Counterfactual Foreground Retrieval (CFR), a leakage-aware evaluation protocol.
CFR evaluates the same query-gallery retrieval task on matched full-image, foreground-only, and shortcut-only. These views separate standard retrieval performance from animal-visible evidence and shortcut evidence. CFR summarizes how much of the full-image retrieval score remains supported by the foreground, while the shortcut signal indicator (SSI) measures how much of the full-image signal is recoverable from the background or from the animal’s body outline, which we isolate with a silhouette-only view. Outline is excluded from the shortcut signal for species whose identity is carried by shape, such as whale flukes and dorsal fins. CFR does not replace full-image accuracy or treat foreground-only retrieval as leakage-free; together, CFR and SSI report the evidence profile behind the score.
blocks.zh:
我们用反事实前景检索(CFR),一种了解渗漏情况的评价程序来解决这个问题。
CFR在匹配的全图像上评价相同的查询-采集检索任务,只评价前景,只评价快捷键. 这些观点将标准检索性能与动物可见证据和捷径证据分开. CFR总结了多少全图像检索分数仍由前方支持,而捷径信号指标(SSI)则测量了多少全图像信号从背景或动物的身体轮廓中可以恢复,我们用仅以硅色的视角隔离. 对于其身份由形状携带的物种,例如鲸鱼鳍和多鳍鱼,大纲被排除在捷径信号之外。 CFR不取代全图像的准确性,也不将仅面向地的检索视为无渗漏;CFR和SI一起报告分数背后的证据剖面.

blocks.en: Alongside the CFR protocol, we update the WildlifeDatasets library [ 12 ] into a leakage-auditable benchmark suite. We add the missing segmentation and evaluation layer on top of existing datasets: foreground masks for roughly 0.5M images from 34 datasets, mask-generation code for future use, and CFR-related evaluation code. All this allows testing whether retrieval is supported by animal-visible evidence, background context, or silhouette cues, whereas previously, only full-image retrieval was reported.
blocks.zh: 除了CFR协议之外,我们更新了"野生动物达塔塞斯"库[12]到一个可渗漏-听觉基准套件. 我们在现有数据集上添加缺失的分区和评价层:34个数据集约0.5M图像的前置口罩、今后使用的口罩生成码和CFR相关评价码。 所有这一切都可以测试检索是否得到动物可见证据、背景或硅胶提示的支持,而以前只报告完整图像检索。

blocks.en: Finally, we use CFR to audit selected models on a wide variety of datasets. The results show that full-image Retrieval@ k k can hide very different evidence profiles. Some model–dataset pairs are strongly foreground-supported, with high CFR and low SSI. Others are overdetermined, i.e., the animal foreground supports retrieval, but background or silhouette cues are also predictive. In the most confounded cases, shortcut-only inputs recover a large fraction of the full-image signal. These results show why full-image accuracy is not enough. It reports only whether retrieval succeeds, but not whether the success comes from the animal or from the dataset shortcuts.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们使用CFR来审计各种数据集的选定模型. 结果显示,全图像检索@ kk可以隐藏非常不同的证据配置. 一些模型 - 数据集对有强大的前景支持,具有较高的CFR和较低的SSI. 另一些则过于确定,即动物前缘支持检索,但背景或硅光提示也具有预测性. 在最令人困惑的情况下,只有快捷键输入才能恢复大部分全图像信号. 这些结果表明,为什么完全图像准确性还不够。 它只报告检索是否成功,而不是成功来自动物还是数据集快捷键.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Animal re-identification has moved from matching hand-designed visual patterns to learning reusable embeddings. Early systems such as StripeCodes [ 24 ] , HotSpotter [ 13 ] , MantaMatcher [ 39 ] , the modified Groth algorithm [ 7 ] , and ALFRE-ID [ 28 ] relied on local features, geometric verification, and database search over markings such as stripes, spots, scars, fins, and contours. Recent work scales this idea with larger benchmarks (e.g., WildlifeReID-10k [ 2 ] ) and multi-species models, including MegaDescriptor [ 12 ] , MiewID [ 30 ] . This progress has made animal re-ID easier to benchmark and reuse, but the evaluation signal remains narrow: rank- k k accuracy and mAP say whether retrieval worked, not what visual evidence made it work.
blocks.zh: 动物的重新识别已经从匹配手设计的视觉模式转移到学习可重复使用的嵌入. 早期的系统如FredeCodes [24],HotSpotter [13],MantaMatcher [39],经过修改的Groth算法 [7],以及ALFRE-ID [28] 依赖于局部特征,几何校验,以及数据库在条纹,斑点,伤疤,鳍和轮廓等标识上的搜索. 近期的工作以更大的基准(如野生动物ReID-10k[2])和多种物种模型,包括MegaDescriptionor [12],MiewID [30] 来衡量这一想法的规模. 这一进展使得动物重新识别更容易基准化和再利用,但评价信号仍然狭窄: kk精准度和mAP表示检索是否有效,而不是视觉证据使其有效.

blocks.en: Leakage in benchmark design. The limits of rank- k k accuracy are especially clear when benchmark construction leaks information across evaluation examples. Prior work has addressed this mainly through better split design, including similarity-aware protocols that reduce overlap from repeated, near-duplicate, or visually similar captures [ 1 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 基准设计中的渗漏. 当基准构建在评价实例中泄露信息时,级别-k k准确度的限度特别明确。 先前的工作主要通过更好的分拆设计来解决了这一问题,包括相似感协议,减少重复的,近似重复的,或视觉上相似的捕获[1,2]的重叠.

blocks.en: Foreground, background, and shortcut cues. The same issue also appears at the pixel level and models can use visual correlations that are predictive in a benchmark but outside the intended identity signal [ 18 ] . Background is a well-known example. It can support prediction on its own, and changing it can change model decisions even when the foreground object is fixed [ 49 ] . In animal re-ID, recent work has addressed this by removing backgrounds, modeling foreground and background separately, or diagnosing whether retrieval relies on coat pattern, background, or laterality cues [ 50 , 32 , 35 ] . Related foreground/background studies in wildlife behavior recognition show the same pattern outside individual identification [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 前景、背景和捷径 同一问题也出现在像素级别上,模型可以使用在基准中具有预测性,但在预期身份信号外的视觉关联[18]. 背景是一个众所周知的例子。 它可以支持自己的预测,改变它可以改变模型的决定,即使前方对象是固定的[49]. 在动物再识别中,最近的工作通过删除背景、分别模拟前景和背景,或判断检索是否依赖于外套图案、背景或后期提示[50、32、35]来解决了这一问题。 野生动物行为识别的相关前缘/背景研究表明,个体识别以外的模式相同[8].

blocks.en: Segmentation masks for benchmark auditing. Separating animal-visible evidence from surrounding context in an existing benchmark requires a foreground mask for every evaluated image. Most animal re-ID benchmarks, however, were built for retrieval evaluation and provide images, identity labels, and evaluation protocols rather than segmentation annotations. A few datasets include masks or part annotations, such as SeaTurtleID2022 [ 1 ] , SealID [ 29 ] , and CzechLynx [ 33 ] , but this is not yet standard. Promptable segmentation with SAM has made mask generation more accessible [ 23 ] , with SAM3 extending this direction to concept-prompted segmentation from text or visual exemplars [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 基准审计的分块罩。 在现有基准中将动物可见证据从周围环境中分离出来,需要为每个被评价的图像提供前置遮罩。 然而,大多数动物再识别基准是为检索评价而建立的,它们提供图像、身份标签和评价协议,而不是分区说明。 少数数据集包括口罩或部分说明,如SeaTurtleID2022 [1],SealID [29],以及ChinoLynx [33],但这尚不标准. 与 SAM 的可快速分解使得面具生成更容易访问 [23], SAM3 从文本或视觉实例中将这个方向扩展到概念催化分解 [10].

blocks.en: 3 Counterfactual Foreground Retrieval
blocks.zh: 3 反事实前景检索

blocks.en: Standard evaluation with full-image Retrieval@ k k measures whether the correct individual is retrieved, but not what visual evidence made the retrieval possible. With that in mind, we introduce C ounterfactual F oreground R etrieval to make such evidence more explicit. CFR keeps the task fixed and changes only the visual input. For each image, we construct matched counterfactual views (full image, foreground-only, and shortcut-only) under the same identity labels, query-gallery structure, model, and scoring protocol.

blocks.en: The counterfactual inputs isolate different sources of retrieval evidence while keeping the same images, labels, and query-gallery protocol. Each original image is transformed into a foreground-only view and one or more shortcut-only views (see Fig. 2 ). The foreground-only view keeps animal-visible pixels and removes the surrounding image. Shortcut-only views remove animal texture while retaining non-foreground cues such as scene context or silhouette.

A method receives high CFR only when it retrieves well under the original full-image input and when retrieval remains strong under the foreground-only input. If full-image retrieval is weak, CFR is low. If full-image retrieval is high but foreground-only retrieval drops, CFR is also low. blocks.en: 3.7 Interpretation
blocks.zh: 3.7 口译

blocks.en:
The proposed evaluation protocol should be read in the same way as standard Retrieval@ k k , with one important difference. Retrieval@ k k reports performance under the original benchmark, whereas CFR and SSI repeat the same evaluation after controlled interventions that selectively remove different sources of visual evidence.
The resulting evidence profile distinguishes changes in retrieval performance caused by removing the animal from those caused by removing the surrounding visual context. Neither CFR nor SSI should be interpreted in isolation. A decrease in CFR is informative only together with SSI. For example, a lower CFR accompanied by low SSI indicates that removing the foreground reduces retrieval while shortcut information remains uninformative. In contrast, a similar decrease together with high SSI indicates that shortcut-only inputs preserve much of the original retrieval signal. Likewise, high SSI should not be interpreted as model failure. It simply indicates that the evaluated benchmark contains shortcut cues that are predictive under the proposed intervention.
blocks.zh:
拟议的评价协议应与标准检索程序(Retrival@kk)相同,但有一个重要的区别。 Retrival@ k k 报告原始基准下的绩效,而CFR和SSI在有控制的干预后重复相同的评价,有选择地去除不同的视觉证据来源.
由此而来的证据剖面区分了因移除动物而导致的检索性能的变化,以及因移除周围视觉环境而导致的变化. 不应孤立地解释反弹道导弹和反导弹武器。 只有与瑞典航天局一起,CFR的减少才说明情况。 例如,较低的CFR加上低SSI表示,去除前缘会减少检索,而快捷键信息则仍然不具有信息参考性. 相比之下,类似的减少加上高SSI表明,仅限快捷输入保留了大部分原始检索信号. 同样,高SSI不应被解释为模型故障。 它只是指出,所评估的基准包含在拟议干预措施下可以预测的捷径提示。

blocks.en: Beyond that, the provided evidence profile can help prioritize future improvements. For example, evidence-confounded and shortcut-driven profiles indicate the need for better train/test splits, more diverse data collection, explicit foreground-aware training, or benchmark curation that reduces identity-correlated shortcut cues. We evaluate some of the ideas below.

blocks.en: 4 Benchmarking Suite
blocks.zh: 4 基准套件

blocks.en: To enable CFR evaluation at scale, we provide segmentation masks for 34 datasets (roughly 0.5M annotations), release the code used to generate them, and substantially extend WildlifeDatasets [ 12 ] so that masks can be loaded in a standardized way for all datasets along the original image, identity label, and annotation metadata.
blocks.zh: 为使CFR能够进行规模评价,我们为34个数据集提供分区口罩(约0.5M注解),释放用于生成的代码,并大幅扩展"野生生物Datasets[12]",这样就可以按照原始图像,身份标签和注释元数据对所有数据集进行标准化加载.

blocks.en: 4.1 Segmentation Masks
blocks.zh: 4.1 片面罩

blocks.en: To enable high-quality mask generation at scale (see example masks in Fig. 2 ), we design a pipeline that combines prompt-based segmentation, conservative candidate selection, and manual quality assurance. Here we provide a short description; more details are available in Appendix S1 .
blocks.zh: 为了能够大规模地产生高质量的口罩(见图2中的例子口罩),我们设计了一个管道,将快速分块、保守的候选人选择和人工质量保证结合起来。 我们在此作一个简短的描述;详见附录S1。

blocks.en: Mask generation. We generate foreground candidates using SAM3 [ 23 , 10 ] . For each dataset, we use a simple dataset-level prompt, such as the species name, a common group name, or the annotated body part for part-based datasets. This keeps mask generation scalable while allowing datasets focused on heads, flanks, or other body parts to use prompts that match the relevant visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 面具一代传. 我们使用 SAM3 生成前景候选人 [23, 10]. 对于每个数据集,我们都会使用简单的数据集级别提示,比如物种名称,共同的群名,或者部分基于数据集的注释体部分. 这保持了面具生成可伸缩性,同时允许以头部,侧翼或其他身体部分为重点的数据集使用匹配相关视觉证据的提示.

blocks.en: Mask acceptance. We select one individual foreground mask for each image whenever a reliable candidate is available. If an annotation has a source bounding box, the selected mask must correspond to the annotated region rather than another animal or background object in the image. If the annotation is already a cropped image or full-image record, use the highest-scoring SAM3 candidate unless dataset-specific checks reject it. We retain rejected candidates and their metadata for audit and debugging. As masks and counterfactual views are constructed per annotation, we handle images with multiple animals or different annotated body parts by following the original annotations.
blocks.zh: 蒙面验收. 只要有可靠的候选人,我们就会为每个图像选择一个单独的前台面具。 如果注释有源边框,选中的面具必须对应注释区域,而不是图像中的另一个动物或背景对象. 如果注解已经是一个被裁剪的图像或全图像记录,则使用得分最高的SAM3候选人,除非数据集特定检查拒绝. 我们保留被否决的候选人及其元数据,用于审计和调试。 由于口罩和反事实视图是按注释构建的,我们通过遵循原注解处理多动物或不同注解的身体部分的图像.

blocks.en: Quality assurance. To verify that the selected masks support reliable foreground and background interventions, we compare them against 400 manually drawn reference masks (50 per random dataset). The agreement is high: median IoU is 98.2%, mean IoU is 96.1%, and 95.1% of samples exceed 90% IoU. Rejected low-confidence candidates provide an additional sanity check: many come from difficult images with occlusion, device artifacts, multiple animals, missing foreground, or ambiguous background.

blocks.en: 5 Evidence Profiles Revealed by CFR
blocks.zh: 5 证据简介 由 CFR 揭示

blocks.en: We use the CFR-ready benchmarking suite to demonstrate what standard full-image retrieval scores hide. The goal is not to rank MiewID and MegaDescriptor by unseen-dataset generalization. Instead, the goal is diagnostic. When a model retrieves the correct individual, does the retrieval remain supported by animal signature, or just background?
blocks.zh: 我们用CFR准备的基准套件来展示标准全图像检索分数隐藏了什么. 目标不是通过不见踪影的数据集概括来给MiewID和MegaDescriptionor排位. 相反,目标是诊断。 当一个模型检索到正确的个体时,检索是否仍然有动物的签名支持,还是仅仅是背景?

blocks.en:
Standard evaluation hides different evidence profiles. A central finding is that similar full-image Retrieval@1 values correspond to different sources of evidence. Some datasets have both high full-image retrieval and high CFR, meaning that the animal foreground is sufficient for identification (see Tab. 2 ). This is the cleanest case for interpreting standard retrieval performance as animal-visible identity matching.
However, high full-image retrieval can also occur when shortcut-only views are predictive. OpenCows2020, AAUZebraFish, and ATRW have strong full-image performance and high CFR, but also high SSI. These datasets are therefore overdetermined: the animal foreground supports retrieval, but identity-correlated shortcut evidence as well. Standard Retrieval@1 alone would not distinguish that.
blocks.zh:
标准评价隐藏了不同的证据简介. 一个中心结论是类似的全图像检索@1值对应不同的证据来源. 一些数据集既具有高全图像检索率,又具有高CFR率,意味着动物前缘足以识别(参见Tab.2. 这是将标准检索性能解释为动物可见身份匹配的最干净的案例.
然而,当只有快捷键的视图具有预测性时,高全图像检索也可能发生. OpenCows2020,AAUZEBRAFish,以及ATRW都有强大的全图像性能和高CFR,但也具有高SSI. 因此,这些数据集的确定性过高:动物前景支持检索,但与身份cor相关的快捷证据也支持. 仅靠标准检索@1无法区分这一点。

blocks.en:
Shortcut signal does not always lead to method failure. High SSI should not be interpreted as a direct failure of the model. In datasets such as OpenCows2020 and AAUZebraFish, CFR remains high. This means that the model can retrieve the correct individual from the animal foreground, even though shortcut-only inputs are also predictive. The issue is therefore not simply that the method ignores the animal; rather, the benchmark contains additional identity-correlated evidence.
A concerning pattern appears when high SSI is paired with low CFR. Saimaa seal and NDD20 show modest full-image retrieval, weaker foreground-only retrieval, and high shortcut recoverability. In this case, full-image Retrieval@1 is weak evidence of animal-foreground identification, because much of the recoverable signal is also present in shortcut-only views. This is the case where standard evaluation is most misleading.
blocks.zh:
快捷信号并不总是导致方法失败. 高SSI不应被解释为模型的直接故障. 在OpenCows2020和AAUZebraFish等数据集中,CFR仍然很高. 这意味着模型可以从动物的前缘取回正确的个体,尽管只有快捷输入也是预测性的. 因此,问题不单单是该方法忽略了动物,而是该基准包含与身份有关的额外证据。
当高SSI与低CFR配对时会出现一种有关模式。 Saimaa海豹和NDD20显示出适度的全图像检索,更弱的前缘只检索,以及高捷径可回收性. 在这种情况下,全图像检索@1是动物前方识别的薄弱证据,因为许多可回收的信号也存在于仅快捷的视图中. 这是标准评价最误导的情况。

blocks.en:
Model comparisons reveal evidence differences. CFR also shows that models with similar full-image performance can rely on different evidence profiles (see Fig. 3 ).
For example, on HumpbackWhaleID, MiewID and MegaDescriptor have similar full-image Retrieval@1, but MiewID has substantially higher shortcut recoverability, while MegaDescriptor retains comparable foreground support with much lower SSI.
The standard metric suggests similar retrieval performance, whereas CFR shows that the supporting evidence differs.
Other datasets show the opposite. On IPanda50 and NDD20, MegaDescriptor obtains much higher full-image Retrieval@1 than MiewID, but this improvement is only partly reflected in CFR and is accompanied by high shortcut recoverability. These cases show why model comparison should not be based only on full-image retrieval: an apparent performance gain may improve foreground or shortcut recoverability, or both.
blocks.zh:
模型比较显示证据差异. CFR还表明,具有类似全图像性能的模型可以依赖不同的证据剖面(见图3 ).
例如,在HumpbackWhaleID上,MiewID和MegaDescriptionor具有相似的全图像 Retrieval@1,但MiewID有相当高的快捷键可回收性,而MegaDescriptionor则以低得多的SSI保留了可比的前缘支持.
标准度量标准表示类似的检索性能,而CFR显示辅助证据不同.
其他数据集显示相反. 在IPanda50和NDD20上,MegaDescriptor获得比MiewID高得多的全图像检索@1,但这一改进只在CFR中部分反映出来,并伴随着高捷径的可回收性. 这些情况表明,为什么模型比较不应仅以全图像检索为基础:表面上的性能收益可能改善前景或快捷方式的可回收性,或两者兼而有之。

blocks.en:
Low shortcut signal gives cleaner interpretation. Datasets with low SSI provide the cleanest interpretation of standard retrieval performance. StripeSpotter, SeaTurtleID2022, Reunion turtles, Amvrakikos turtles, WhaleSharkID, BelugaID, and MacaqueFaces have low shortcut recoverability relative to their full-image performance. On these datasets, foreground-only retrieval largely preserves the useful signal, while shortcut-only retrieval contributes little. Full-image Retrieval@1 is therefore more directly supported by animal-visible evidence.
Low shortcut signal should not be confused with high retrieval performance. NyalaData has low SSI, but MegaDescriptor has substantially lower CFR than MiewID. This shows that low SSI only indicates that the observed signal is not primarily recoverable from shortcut-only inputs; it does not imply that the method retrieves individuals accurately.
blocks.zh:
低捷径信号给出更清洁的解释. 低SSI的数据集为标准检索性能提供了最干净的解释. FriedeSpotter,SeaTurtleID2022,留尼汪龟,Amvrakikos龟,WhaleSharkID,BelugaID,和MacaqueFaces相对其全图像性能而言的捷径可回收性较低. 在这些数据集上,仅面向前景的检索在很大程度上保留了有用的信号,而仅面向快捷的检索则贡献甚微. 全图像检索@1因此更直接地得到动物可见证据的支持.
低捷径信号不应与高检索性能相混淆. 尼亚拉 数据具有较低的SSI,但MegaDescriptor的CFR大大低于MiewID. 这表明低SSI只表示观测到的信号主要不能从快捷输入中恢复;并不意味着该方法能准确检索个人.

blocks.en: Takeaway. Our evaluation shows that full-image Retrieval@ k k is not sufficient to interpret animal identification results. Similar scores can arise from foreground-supported matching, overdetermined benchmarks where both animal and shortcut evidence are predictive, or cases where foreground support is weak. CFR and SSI keep the standard retrieval task intact, but turn a single performance number into an evidence profile that shows whether the retrieved identity is supported by the animal foreground and/or shortcut.
blocks.zh: 外卖 我们的评价表明,完整图像检索@ kk不足以解释动物识别结果。 类似的分数可能来自前景支持的匹配,在动物和捷径证据都具有预测性的情况下,或者前景支持薄弱的情况下,过度确定的基准. CFR和SSI保持标准检索任务完好无损,但将一个单一的性能号转换成一个证据剖面,显示被检索的身份是否得到动物前缘和/或快捷键的支持.

blocks.en: 6 Foreground-Mixed Training as Mitigation
blocks.zh: 6 前地混合培训作为缓解

One possible explanation for low foreground retrieval is that foreground-only
inputs are unfamiliar to models trained only on full images. If so, exposing a
model to masked inputs during training should improve CFR and reduce SSI. If
shortcut cues remain predictive after this intervention, they are more likely
to reflect properties of the data than the foreground-only input itself.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: One of the main goals of evaluation is to guide future development. A benchmark score tells us whether a model performs well, but it rarely tells us where to spend the next six months of work. Should we build a better model? Collect more data? Or rethink the benchmark itself? Counterfactual retrieval addresses this gap by asking not only whether retrieval was correct, but also what visual evidence supported it. By separating foreground-supported retrieval from shortcut-supported retrieval, it provides information that standard retrieval metrics cannot, making it easier to decide what to investigate next.
blocks.zh: 评价的主要目标之一是指导今后的发展。 基准分数告诉我们一个模型是否表现良好,但它很少告诉我们今后六个月的工作地点。 我们应该建立一个更好的模型吗? 收集更多数据? 还是重新思考基准本身? 反事实检索不仅通过询问检索是否正确,而且通过何种视觉证据支持检索,解决了这一差距。 通过将前景支持的检索与捷径支持的检索分开,它提供了标准检索度量标准无法提供的信息,从而更容易决定下一步要调查什么.

blocks.en: The evidence profile, however, is only the starting point. By itself, it does not tell us what to change. Instead, it turns a single benchmark score into a more focused set of questions. Is the model struggling to recognize individuals? Is the benchmark making the task artificially easy? Or are both contributing? Different answers naturally lead to different solutions. Weak foreground support points toward the recognition model, training data, or species-specific representations. Strong shortcut recoverability shifts attention to the benchmark itself, raising questions about data split, repeated backgrounds, acquisition conditions, or other identity-correlated cues. In many cases, both the model and the benchmark deserve closer attention.
blocks.zh: 然而,证据概况只是起点。 它本身并不告诉我们要改变什么。 相反,它把单一基准得分变成一组重点更突出的问题。 模特儿在努力认清个人吗? 基准是否人为地使任务变得容易? 还是两者都有贡献? 不同的答案自然会导致不同的解决方案. 前景支持薄弱,指向识别模式、培训数据或具体物种的表述。 强有力的捷径可回收性将注意力转移到基准本身,引起关于数据分割、重复背景、获取条件或其他身份相关提示的问题。 在许多情况下,模型和基准都值得更加关注。

blocks.en: In any case, answering these questions requires looking beyond any metric. Inspecting representative examples, reviewing dataset metadata, examining train/test splits, or using feature-level interpretability methods such as Grad-CAM [ 37 ] and attention visualization [ 11 ] can help identify where the recovered evidence comes from. Together, these analyses can reveal whether the observed behavior reflects shortcut cues, benchmark design, or genuine visual representations. We see these methods as complementary. Counterfactual retrieval highlights that shortcut exists at the benchmark level, while feature-level analysis helps explain where it comes from and why.
blocks.zh: 无论如何,回答这些问题需要超越任何标准。 检查有代表性的例子,审查数据集元数据,检查列车/测试拆分,或者采用Grad-CAM[37]和注意力可视化[11]等特征级可解释性方法,可以帮助确定所找到的证据来自何处. 这些分析可以共同揭示所观察到的行为是否反映了捷径提示,基准设计,还是真实的视觉表现. 我们认为这些方法是相辅相成的。 反事实检索突出显示在基准级别存在快捷键,而特征级别分析则有助于解释其来源和原因.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
Standard retrieval metrics tell us whether the correct individual was retrieved, but not what evidence made that retrieval possible. With that in mind, we introduced Counterfactual Foreground Retrieval that make the evaluation evidence measurable rather than implicit.
Across a wide range of datasets, we show that similar retrieval performance can reflect fundamentally different evidence profiles. Rather than introducing another score to optimize, CFR and SSI provide information that helps guide model development, benchmark design, and future investigation. We hope this encourages evaluation that asks not only whether retrieval is accurate, but also what evidence makes it accurate.
blocks.zh:
标准检索的衡量标准告诉我们正确的个人是否被检索,但并不是什么证据使得检索成为可能。 有鉴于此,我们提出了反事实前景检索,使评价证据可以衡量,而不是隐含。
在一系列广泛的数据集中,我们显示,类似的检索性能可以反映根本不同的证据概况。 反之,CFR和SSI提供了有助于指导模型开发、基准设计和未来调查的信息,而不是引入另一个最佳分数。 我们希望这鼓励评价不仅询问检索是否准确,而且询问哪些证据使其准确。

blocks.en: However, evidence-aware evaluation is only one part of this process. CFR is a diagnostic rather than a causal explanation of model behavior. It reveals whether retrieval remains supported by animal-visible evidence under the proposed counterfactual protocol, but it does not identify the exact source of shortcut cues or explain why they arise. Understanding those mechanisms still benefits from complementary analyses, such as feature-level interpretability, dataset inspection, and ecological expertise. We see these directions as natural next steps toward more reliable and interpretable wildlife identification systems.
blocks.zh: 然而,了解证据的评价只是这一进程的一部分。 CFR是对模型行为的一种诊断而非因果解释. 它揭示了在拟议的反事实协议下,检索是否仍然得到动物可见证据的支持,但它没有确定快捷提示的确切来源,也没有解释为什么出现这些提示. 了解这些机制仍然得益于补充分析,例如地物层面的解释性、数据集检查和生态专门知识。 我们认为这些方向是走向更可靠和可解释的野生生物识别系统的下一个自然步骤。

blocks.en: Appendix S1 Masks and Counterfactual Inputs
blocks.zh: 附录S1 面具和反事实输入

blocks.en:
Mask generation details : Given that the available datasets span diverse species and annotations, mask generation cannot simply rely on a single prompt and strategy.
We therefore generated SAM3 [ 23 , 10 ] -mask using dataset-specific prompts matched to the species and dataset.
Depending on the dataset, prompts referred either to the whole animal (e.g., “cow” and “fish”) or to the annotated body part (e.g., “sea turtle head” and “bear head”). To get the best mask possible, we also included alternative prompts, when appropriate, and selected the highest-confidence one. For more details about the prompts used, see Table S1 .
For datasets with available bounding boxes, we compared all SAM3 boxes with the annotation and selected the one with the highest IoU. We discarded all masks with IoU < < 0.5.
blocks.zh:
面具生成细节 : 鉴于现有数据集跨越不同的物种和说明,遮罩生成不能简单地依赖单一的即时策略.
因此,我们利用与物种和数据集相匹配的数据集特定提示,生成了SAM3 [23, 10]-mask.
根据数据集的不同,提示要么指整个动物(如“牛”和“鱼”),要么指附加说明的身体部分(如“海龟头”和“熊头”)。 为了获得尽可能好的面具,我们还酌情包括了替代提示,并选择了最高自信的提示。 关于所用提示的详情,见表S1。
对于有可用边框的数据集,我们比较了所有SAM3框和注释,并选择了具有最高IoU的框. 我们丢弃了所有带有IoU < 0.5的口罩。

blocks.en:
Mask quality assurance details : To further assess mask quality, we manually annotated the visible foreground (i.e., the body of the animal) for 50 randomly sampled images from eight representative datasets using X-AnyLabeling [ 44 ] and compared the resulting masks with the corresponding SAM3 predictions using IoU. Median IoU exceeded 96% for every audited dataset and reached 98.2% overall (Table S2 ). The main failure mode occurred in NyalaData, where the generic “animal” prompt occasionally selected the wrong individual in multi-animal scenes.
Overall, the audited masks are highly accurate, with errors substantially smaller than the controlled low- and medium-severity mask perturbations under which CFR and SSI remain stable (Sec. S2 ). This more than suggests that the observed mask quality is well within the range needed for reliable CFR evaluation.

blocks.en:
Making counterfactual inputs :
All accepted masks were used to construct the counterfactual inputs evaluated by CFR. All views were generated from the original annotation crop used for the standard retrieval evaluation. The full-image view was left unchanged. The foreground-only view retained pixels inside the accepted mask, whereas the shortcut-only view retained those outside it. The silhouette-only view replaced the foreground texture with a solid black silhouette. All removed regions were filled with the ImageNet RGB mean before applying each model’s standard resizing and normalization. Consequently, every view shared the same image crop, identity labels, query–gallery protocol, and preprocessing, differing only in the visual evidence available to the retrieval model. To allow reproducibility and future use,
we made the code publicly available.

blocks.en: Appendix S2 Sensitivity to Mask and Image Corruptions
blocks.zh: 附录S2 对面具和图像腐败的敏感性

blocks.en:
CFR and SSI rely on counterfactual image views generated from segmentation masks.
Their practical usefulness therefore depends on whether these evidence profiles remain stable under realistic annotation errors and common image degradations. We evaluate this directly by applying controlled perturbations to the masks and images while keeping the retrieval task, annotations, gallery, and models fixed.
We consider nine deterministic perturbations at three severity levels across all 34 datasets and both evaluated models, resulting in 3 × 9 × 34 × 2 = 1836 3\times 9\times 34\times 2=1836 paired evaluations.
blocks.zh:
CFR和SSI依赖于从分割口罩产生的反事实图像视图.
因此,其实际效用取决于这些证据简介在现实的注释错误和常见图像退化的情况下是否保持稳定。 我们通过对口罩和图像进行可控扰动来直接评估这一点,同时将检索任务、说明、画廊和模型固定下来。
我们认为,在所有34个数据集和两个评估模型中,有9个确定性扰动在3个严重性级别,结果3×9×34×2 = 1836 3\time 9\time 34\time 2=1836 配对评价。

blocks.en: Experimental setup. We consider four mask perturbations and five image perturbations. Mask perturbations modify approximately 5 % 5\% , 10 % 10\% , or 20 % 20\% of the accepted foreground area by applying erosion, dilation, interior false negatives, or exterior false positives. Image perturbations include Gaussian noise, Gaussian blur, JPEG compression, foreground CutOut, and background CutOut at low, medium, and high severity levels.
blocks.zh: 实验设置. 我们考虑四次面具扰动和五次图像扰动。 遮罩扰动通过应用侵蚀、放大、内侧假阴性或外侧假阳性来修改约5% 5% ,10% 10% 10 ,或20% 20% 。 图像扰动包括高斯噪音,高斯模糊,JPEG压缩,前缘剪切,以及低,中,高重度水平的背景剪切.

blocks.en: Boundary errors have little effect. Across all datasets, both metrics remain close to the identity line under low and medium perturbations (Fig. S1 ), indicating that moderate segmentation inaccuracies have little influence on the resulting evidence profiles. Boundary erosion, dilation, and exterior false positives consistently produce only small changes, even at the highest severity. These results suggest that CFR and SSI are robust to the level of mask imprecision expected from modern automatic segmentation models.
blocks.zh: 边界错误影响不大。 在所有数据集中,两个度量衡仍然接近中低度扰动(图S1)下的身份线,表明中度分解不准确对由此产生的证据剖面影响不大。 边界侵蚀、扩张和外在的假阳性持续产生很小的变化,即使是在最严重的情况下。 这些结果表明,CFR和SSI的强度达到了现代自动分割模型所预期的面具不精确的程度。

blocks.en: Removing animal parts changes the metrics as expected. The largest mask-induced changes occur for interior false negatives, which remove regions from the animal itself rather than perturbing its boundary. Likewise, among image perturbations, Foreground CutOut consistently produces larger changes than Background CutOut. This behavior matches the intended interpretation of both metrics. CFR decreases when discriminative foreground appearance is removed, while SSI changes according to how evidence is redistributed between the foreground and shortcut views. In contrast, Background CutOut removes contextual information while leaving the animal appearance intact, producing substantially smaller changes.
blocks.zh: 清除动物的部位会像预期的那样改变测量标准. 最大的面具引起的变化发生在内部的假底片上,这些假底片将区域从动物本身中除去,而不是扰动动物的边界. 同样,在图像扰动中,Foreground CutOut持续产生比Base CutOut更大的变化. 这种行为符合两个度量衡的预期解释. CFR在删除歧视性前缘外观时会减少,而SSI则根据证据如何在前缘和快捷视图之间重新分配而改变. 相比之下,背景CutOut删除了背景信息,同时使动物外观完好无损,产生显著较小的变化.

blocks.en: Common image degradations have limited impact. Gaussian noise, blur, and JPEG compression have little effect at low and medium severity and produce noticeable changes only under strong degradation. Importantly, these perturbations affect the entire image rather than selectively removing identity evidence, making their impact substantially smaller than Foreground CutOut. This indicates that the proposed evidence profiles are more sensitive to the loss of discriminative animal information than to typical image-quality degradation.
blocks.zh: 常见的图像退化影响有限. 高斯噪声,模糊,JPEG压缩在低度和中度强度下效果甚微,只有在强烈降解下才会产生显著变化. 重要的是,这些扰动影响到整个图像,而不是有选择地去除身份证据,使其影响大大小于前地剪除. 这表明,拟议的证据简介对失去歧视性动物信息比典型的图像质量退化更为敏感。

blocks.en: Overall evaluation. Our experiments show that the conclusions drawn from CFR and SSI are largely insensitive to realistic imperfections in the counterfactual construction. Moderate mask errors and common image degradations have little or no influence on the resulting evidence profiles, whereas perturbations that remove discriminative animal appearance produce the expected changes in both metrics. This gives us confidence that CFR and SSI capture meaningful differences in the visual evidence supporting retrieval rather than artifacts from imperfect masks.
blocks.zh: 总体评价。 我们的实验表明,从CFR和SSI中得出的结论对反事实构造中的现实的不完善性基本上不敏感. 中度遮罩误差和常见图像退化对由此产生的证据剖面影响很小或根本没有,而消除歧视性动物外观的扰动则会产生两个度量的预期变化. 这使我们相信,CFR和SSI捕捉到支持检索的视觉证据中有意义的差异,而不是来自不完善面具的文物。

blocks.en: Figure S1 : Robustness of CFR and SSI to controlled mask and image perturbations. CFR and SSI remain stable under moderate perturbations and change primarily when discriminative animal evidence is removed, consistent with their intended interpretation. Each point represents one paired evaluation on 34 datasets using two models (e.g., MegaDescriptor and MiewID), comparing the clean metric with its perturbed counterpart. Rows correspond to increasing perturbation severity (low, medium, high), and columns show Clear CFR and SSI. ○ \bigcirc indicates mask perturbations, □ \square generic image degradations, and △ \triangle targeted evidence removal (e.g., foreground / background CutOut). The orange curve shows the median perturbed value in ten equal-width bins of the clean metric, with interquartile-range error bars.

blocks.en: The CFR benchmark spans 34 datasets with very different species, acquisition setups, and annotation types. Table S3 summarizes each by species or group, image conditions, the CFR unit we embed, the intended biometric, and the silhouette role. They cover fish, reptiles, birds, and a range of mammals, under conditions from zoo video to camera traps, drones, aerial surveys, and underwater photography.
